provenance.notes: Position Paper form from the official 2025 reviewer instructions.

notes: The ICML 2025 reviewer page says use of generative AI tools (such as LLMs) for reviewing is strictly prohibited and that no submission or review content may be entered into them. LLM-written content is therefore hidden in this export.

sections.label: Position
sections.guidance: Does the paper clearly state a position on a machine learning topic? Select No if it only describes new research without advocating a position.

sections.label: Position In Title
sections.guidance: Can a reader understand the position from the title alone?

sections.label: Paper Summary
sections.guidance: Summarize the contributions and the advocated position, without critique.

sections.label: Strengths and Weaknesses
sections.guidance: Assess support, relevance, discussion potential and citations. Do not comment on whether you agree with the position.

sections.label: Support
sections.guidance: How well the paper supports its position with clear reasoning and evidence.

sections.label: Significance
sections.guidance: How well the paper shows the position is important.

sections.label: Discussion Potential
sections.guidance: Potential to inspire constructive discussion in the ICML community.

sections.label: Argument Clarity
sections.guidance: Clarity of presentation, including writing style.

sections.label: Related Work
sections.guidance: Degree of discussion of, and citations to, relevant literature and events.

sections.label: Questions
sections.guidance: Numbered questions, only where answers could change your opinion.

labels.2: willing to defend, but likely missed central parts or related work
